question: Which state had the first female Governor in independent India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Pointsa__**

 
• Sarojini Naidu was the first woman governor of a state in independent India.
 
• Indian freedom fighter Sarojini Naidu became the first** female Governor of a state in independent India when she was appointed as Governor of the United Provinces, now Uttar Pradesh, in 1947.**
 
• She governed Uttar Pradesh from 15 August 1947 to 2 March 1949.
 
• She is also known as the 'Nightingale of India', Naidu also served as the first Indian woman President of the Indian National Congress.
 
• She was born on February 13, 1879.
